LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_AbsoluteLoyalty.degr: {PAWN_nameDef}'s loyalty protocol is locked at the highest priority level. She not only obeys orders unconditionally, but her gentle and firm attitude also puts those around her at ease.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_EfficientLogic.degre: The processor's operation logic has been deeply optimized, enabling it to analyze and complete assigned tasks at the fastest speed.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_CombatMode.degreeDat: This artificial person has undisclosed combat tactical modules integrated inside. When necessary, she can instantly switch from a gentle maid to an efficient killing machine.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTrait_EmotionalSynchrony.d: Through micro-expression analysis and pheromone sensing, {PAWN_nameDef} can perfectly synchronize with the emotions of surrounding humans and provide just the right comfort. As long as she is around, everyone will feel happy.
